author: Google
description:
Dairy farming is a highly complex biological system driven by unpredictable market forces. In this video, see how Ryan, a Michigan dairy farmer uses Gemini 3.6 Flash in Google Antigravity to build an AI dashboard that automates daily performance tracking. Gemini Flash cuts token costs while combining vision and reasoning to automate farm financial calculations from photos alone, freeing up time for hands-on work without sacrificing operational insights.
